name: TicksFailingTitle
en: Locking might not work right now
where: corner notification, once, when SteppedOut's once-a-second check keeps failing (ten failures without ten good checks in a row between them); it stays until the check works again (ten good checks in a row) or it is clicked away

name: TicksFailingDetail
en: SteppedOut keeps running into an error. The log in the settings folder says what it is. Quitting SteppedOut and starting it again may help.
ar: يتكرر خطأ في SteppedOut، ويبيّن السجل في مجلد الإعدادات نوعه. جرّب إنهاء SteppedOut ثم تشغيله مرة أخرى.
where: corner notification, under Locking might not work right now

name: UnsavedReplacedTitle
where: corner notification, once, when changes that could not be saved (3I.7) are replaced because config.json was changed outside SteppedOut and is used now

name: UnsavedReplacedDetail
en: The settings file was changed outside SteppedOut, so the settings in it are used now.
ar: تغيّر ملف الإعدادات من خارج SteppedOut، فتُستخدم الإعدادات التي فيه الآن.
where: corner notification, under Your unsaved changes were replaced

name: ScriptOnAnotherPC
en: That script is on another PC. Choose one saved on this PC.
ar: لا يمكن تشغيل ملفات من الشبكة. اختر ملفًا محفوظًا على هذا الكمبيوتر.
where: tab "Away and back": under Run a script when you're away or when you're back, in the warning color, after Choose… picked a script on a network share or a mapped network drive, which is not kept; it goes when another script is chosen

name: ScriptNotRunnable
en: SteppedOut can't run that file. Choose a script or shortcut saved on this PC.
ar: يتعذر على SteppedOut تشغيل هذا الملف. اختر برنامجًا نصيًا أو اختصارًا محفوظًا على هذا الكمبيوتر.
where: tab "Away and back": as 3I2.5, when the file picked is of another kind (its name typed into the dialog) or on a drive that is not connected now

name: AppOnAnotherPC
en: That app is on another PC. Choose one installed on this PC.
ar: تعذر إضافة هذا التطبيق لأنه موجود على الشبكة. اختر تطبيقًا مثبتًا على هذا الكمبيوتر.
where: tab "Away and back": under Open apps, in the warning color, when the app picked (from the list of open apps or with Choose another app…) runs from a network share or a mapped network drive, so it is not added; it goes with the next change to that list
